Bright hello cargo crew,
The kennel attendant sent an update on spare blankets and I want to pass along a calm note for everyone handling the pet flow today. Please keep the spare stack easy to reach, and check that each blanket stays clean, dry, and free of loose threads before it goes near a kennel. Small details matter here, because a neat setup helps us reduce stress for the animals and keeps the handoff smooth for the team.

I also want to flag the paperwork side so we stay steady and safe. <<FACT F082>> Make sure the travel file stays matched to the crate tag, the feeding notes, and the contact details already in the system. If anything looks off, pause the transfer and bring it to the senior coordinator right away, since speed never outranks animal welfare on this desk. When we stay patient and consistent, the cabin team can monitor each pet more comfortably and the travelers get a cleaner experience.

Thanks for keeping the tone gentle and the checks thorough. If Grace Park or Lucia Tanaka comes through with Ruby, please give them the same warm, quiet treatment we would want for any family traveling with a companion animal. A steady hand, a kind voice, and careful spacing around the kennel area go a long way. I appreciate everyone who keeps Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk focused on safety first and on a reassuring handoff for every pet.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
